Application: 0x10000
Partition table: 0x8000
Bootloader: 0x0 (generated by PlatformIO)
Merged image: 0x0 (bootloader + partition table + application)
Use `pio run -e cardputer-adv -t upload` for a complete flash, or esptool:
esptool.py --chip esp32s3 --port PORT --baud 1500000 write_flash 0x0 fiberscout-v1-cardputer-adv-merged.bin
